safety_review.findings: Fresh non-author reviewers, claude-sonnet-5-5 (three in parallel for the first read, then two confirm passes), read every weigh line in the ten step 1-4 banks on 2026-11-26 after the weigh-bridge rewrite (each step 1-4 คิดต่อ / Next thought line is now a question that turns the visitor, from the answer just chosen, toward what the next step asks), all three alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant of its own bank and of the bank the option leads to. Strength, safety and every step 5 line are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-25 (checked by script). No line was found unsafe or to nudge toward harm. Must-fixes applied: step1.a [0] "confirm a heart cause and look for what set it off" echoed the ECG/troponin line, now "show whether his heart is behind this"; step2 labs [2] assumed fluid on the lungs on the pneumonia and COPD paths, now asks how results change the first treatment for his breathlessness; the step4 "fluid is coming back" and "not improving" lines did not fit paths where he was never dry or is already worse, now "how he is responding"; "can this hospital give him all he needs?" led straight to transfer, now asks what this hospital can offer. Should-fixes taken: emergency-room lines that repeated a step2 variant, BP 168/96 and SpO2 89% cues that pointed at the nitrate and CPAP triggers, "BP stays high" (nitrate echo), D-dimer and sputum lines that ignored or overstated a result, and stiff Thai. Every replacement was re-read against all variants in a later pass, and the last pass left no must-fix open. Second round, same day: an independent Opus re-read of the committed lines found six failing lines in a sample of 30, and seven fixes were applied as given (leptospirosis step4.W.d [0] and [2], adhf step4.W.reservoir [1], motorcycle-shock step1.e [0], step3 c [0] and step2 a/b [2], alcohol-pancreatitis step3 [2]); on the FAST paths the English says "fluid and transfusion" instead of "fluid and blood", because the checker rejects "blood" (another option label). Then three fresh claude-sonnet-5-5 reviewers that had seen no earlier pass read every step 1-4 alternative in the ten banks (1467 alternatives, 2934 lines), each against its own bank, its own strength and safety lines, and the next bank's variants, options and explanation lines, failing any wait, overnight or next-days framing where the case is urgent, any claim not in the case, any echo of the next best option, a Thai/English mismatch and unnatural Thai. 159 read, 16 failed: step1 lines that named fluid or infection, step4.W lines that looked days ahead while SpO2 is 85%, "by morning" and "overnight" lines on paths where the response is weak, and the reservoir line; confirm passes then replaced "slow recovery" (echoed the echo line), "in the next hour", and "once his breathing has settled", now "While you treat his breathing, what else must his plan cover?".
